summary: Calls and values match, but member mapping and operation order do not meet the verification standard.
issues: The field at this + 0x0c and the result fields at offsets 0x00 and 0x04 are accessed without named members.

The high P-code reads and computes the flags at 0x6d8514–0x6d851b before zeroing result offset 0x04 at 0x6d8520. The reversed code zeros that field first, following the decompilation but conflicting with the independent P-code.
fix_instructions: Define structures with named members at offsets 0x0c, 0x00, and 0x04, then use those members.
Compute the new flags value first, set the offset 0x04 field to zero, then store the computed flags value at offset 0x00.
